findings.title: Claim's selectors match no device on offer
findings.cause: request gpu of ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-vtlct-gpu-2l45s asks for devices of DeviceClass tpu.example.com that satisfy the selector device.attributes["tpu.example.com"].model == "v6e", and the scheduler finds none it can allocate among the 2 devices on offer, most of them free: the selectors match no device the driver publishes (an attribute name or value that differs, or a domain the attribute is not under); Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.command: kubectl get resourceclaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-vtlct-gpu-2l45s -n kd-dra-selector-no-match -o jsonpath='{.spec.devices.requests}'

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 cannot allocate all claims. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.what: the devices on offer and their attributes

findings.fix: Compare the selectors with the attributes in the driver's ResourceSlices (kubectl get resourceslices -o yaml) and correct the expression; a driver's attributes are under its own domain, as device.attributes["<driver>"].<name>.
